notes.title: Soundtrack and Artbook Now Available, Minor Feature and Support Language Updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Soundtrack and Artbook of 'Insomnia: Theater in the Head' is now available, with a discount of -10% off for the first launch (for one week), and a discount of -10% off for the deluxe version (supports complete the set).
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247230
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255160
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30111

If you like our game, you can support us by buying the deluxe edition/soundtrack/artbook, thank you very much!

If you haven't gotten your hands on the game yet, we'll be offering a 20%off discount on February 27th, so you can get this game then.
[quote]The local directory for downloading and installing the soundtrack is
X:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\music\Insomnia Theater In The Head Soundtrack

The local directory for downloading and installing the artbook is
X:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Insomnia Theater In The Head\Insomnia Theater In The Head Artbook[/quote]
[h3]Minor Feature Update[/h3]
We've added a new button to the game(buttons will be unlocked after completing the game), click on the drawing board in the upper right corner to directly access the directory where your "insomnia paintings" are stored.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892350/5abc4a8da0e5481e48ceb125fb97635cf5a9422c.png[/img]
[b]Tips[/b]: Resetting the game will cause the button to disappear, but you can still find the painting of the last act in the local directory.

The painting of the last act in the previous version will be saved to the local directory of the game, the specific path is
Installation path \Theater In The Head_Data\Paintings

[h3]Support Language Updates[/h3]
'Insomnia: Theater in the Head' is now fully supported in Japanese, Korean and Turkish. Many thanks to the translators who provided us with Japanese/Korean/Turkish translations:
[quote]Japanese - Yezi Fanyi
Korean-BENBENNBEN
Turkish-Cansun Coşkun[/quote]
If you want to provide translations for the game in other languages, please feel free to leave a message directly in the Steam discussion forum or send an email to contact@perfectdaystudio.com, thanks in the advance:)

Recently a major earthquake occurred in Turkey/Syria, we express our deep condolences and sincere sympathy to the victims and their families, and wish the people an early victory over the disaster and rebuild their homes.


Perfect Day Studio

notes.title: "Insomnia" 1.0.1 Update - Added Achievement Support
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thanks for your love and recognition of the game "Insomnia" ːsteamhappyː

The 1.01 Update has been released, and the details are as follows:
[h2]Added Achievement Support[/h2]
We have added achievements support to the game.

You can click [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2085360/achievements]here[/url][/b] to view the achievements of the game.

Players who have played the game before will automatically unlock act-related achievements (excluding Act 8), and other achievements need to be played again to unlock.

Optimized the display of some interfaces.

At the same time, we have fixed some problems that have been reported so far. The details are as follows:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[quote][list]
[*] When clicking on the cabinet in Act 4, you can click on the handle of the subway to switch before the ball rolls out so that the abnormal animation display bug.
[*] Fixed a bug where a drop of water was displayed on the fish tank in Act 6.
[/list][/quote]
[h3]Gentle Reminder[/h3]
In Act 8, everyone's paintings will be saved to the local directory of the game. The specific path is:
[quote]Installation path \Theater In The Head_Data\Paintings[/quote]
You can go directly to the installation path by right-clicking the game in the Steam library -> Manage -> Browse Local Files.

Go check it out ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Promotion reminder[/h2]
Valve has helped us extend the -20% off discount until the end of the Winter Sale, and "A Perfect Day" will also be discounted during the Winter Sale.

If you haven't bought these games/or only have one of them, this is a good time to get the game during Winter Saleːsteamhappyː
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29165/

Let’s embrace Insomnia and say good night to ourselves!

Perfect Day Studio

notes.title: Insomnia: Theater in the Head - Small Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

Thank you very much for your love for the game "Insomnia" ːsteamhappyː

At present, we have made an emergency fix for the problem that the setting menu can't be exited on some laptops with 16:10, so as to experience the game better.

If you encounter other bugs during the game, Please describe the bug or issue as detailed as possible, preferably with screenshots and specific actions that have triggered the bug. And please attach the log and send the bug description to contact@perfectdaystudio.com.

Besides, you may also join our [url=https://discord.gg/hfvkzTq6Vh]discord[/url] or directly report the bugs in the Steam community.

[b]Default Log Directory[/b]
Windows
C:\Users\admin\AppData\LocalLow\Perfect Day Studio\Theater In The Head\Player.log
Mac
Users/<name>/Library/Logs/Perfect Day Studio/Theater In The Head/Player.log

[h3]Preview[/h3]
We will launch update 1.01 next week, which will fix some bugs and implement achievements, so stay tuned!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892350/3f89db457807f943f7be69e771ecb6916c8843e0.gif[/img]
